name: fix-1913
title: #1913 — a parallelogram over four points on a circle is its rectangle (ADR-628), on main

cases.title: Four points on a circle, two sides given, then «מקבילית» — a 3 × 4 rectangle, no note
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A true rectangle ABCD inscribed in the circle, with AB = 3 and BC = 4 labelled, all four corners on the circle, and NO amber «לא נמצאה תצורה…» note. It appears within about a second.
cases.before: A crossed (bow-tie) quadrilateral drawn under the amber «לא נמצאה תצורה שמקיימת את כל הדרישות יחד…» note, after a search of several seconds.

cases.title: The same without sides, then «הציגו תצורה אחרת» three times — rectangles only
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A rectangle at once, and every press of «הציגו תצורה אחרת» shows another rectangle (different proportions), never a crossed or slanted shape.
cases.before: A rectangle too, but only after a short search; unchanged for the student apart from speed.

cases.title: «מעוין ABCD» over four points on a circle draws a square at once
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A square ABCD inscribed in the circle (four equal sides, right corners), drawn immediately, green.
cases.before: Refused after 8–11 seconds with «לא ניתן: «מעוין ABCD» סותר נתון קודם… הסיבה: |AB| = |BC|.» — a false refusal; a square fits.

cases.title: «ריבוע ABCD» over four points on a circle draws a square at once
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A square inscribed in the circle, drawn immediately, green.
cases.before: Refused after about 11 seconds as over-constrained («|AB| = |BC|»).

cases.title: A side given, then «מעוין» — a square of side 3
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A square inscribed in the circle with AB = 3 labelled; the circle has shrunk to fit it (radius ≈ 2.1).
cases.before: Refused after about 11 seconds as over-constrained.

cases.title: REFUSAL — «מקבילית ACBD» with AB = 3, BC = 4 cannot hold and is refused naming the right angle
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: The last line is refused at once with «לא ייתכן: מול הזווית הישרה ב-C נמצא היתר AB, הצלע הארוכה ביותר במשולש — אבל |AB| = 3 בעוד |BC| = 4. בדקו את הנתונים.» The four points and the two segments stay as they were; nothing crossed is drawn. (This is the same message «מלבן ACBD» already gives.)
cases.before: Committed: a crossed, impossible figure drawn under the amber «לא נמצאה תצורה…» note after about 10 seconds.

cases.title: Control — off a circle a parallelogram stays a general parallelogram
cases.lookFor: A slanted parallelogram ABCD with AB = 3 and BC = 4 — NOT a rectangle (no right-angle marks), not crossed.

cases.title: Control — «מלבן ABCD» over four points on a circle, as before
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: A rectangle inscribed in the circle, drawn at once, green.

cases.title: Control — «טרפז ABCD» over four points on a circle is still a trapezoid, not forced into a rectangle
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: An (isosceles) trapezoid inscribed in the circle — one pair of parallel sides, slanted legs, no right angles — not crossed.

cases.title: The English spelling draws the same 3 × 4 rectangle
lines: A, B, C and D on the circle
cases.lookFor: The same 3 × 4 rectangle inscribed in the circle as T1, no note.
cases.before: Crossed under the amber note, as T1.

cases.title: Control — the parallelogram first, the circle after: the rectangle 2-D already drew
lines: A, B, C ו-D על המעגל
cases.lookFor: The parallelogram becomes a rectangle with the circle through its corners (unchanged behaviour).
